propositions: The Jira reconciler must be relocated from src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/ to an ordinary rebar.reconciler subpackage, eliminating all lazy_load, spec_from_file_location, and sys.path.insert loader patterns across src/ and tests/

The bridge spawn chain (subprocess → rebar bridge sync → python -m rebar_reconciler) must be collapsed to a direct spawn of python -m rebar.reconciler with start_new_session=True and process-group reaping via rebar._proc.reap_process_group on timeout

Three retired rollback toggles (REBAR_RECONCILER_CREATE_ROUTE, REBAR_RECONCILER_WRITE_FACADE, REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP), five dormant modules, dead code halves in outbound_fields.py and MutationAction pairs, and the _call_with_retry function must be deleted unconditionally

The reconciler must run through a single guarded core (run_guarded_pass) that takes the lease, heartbeats, honors pause, and publishes the disposition, eliminating a bug where library and MCP bridge_sync bypassed the guarded core
Bridge scratch must migrate from repository-root bridge_state/ to .rebar/bridge/ with keep-last-N retention (5 snapshots, 5 sync logs, 30-day alert window), pruned on every persisted pass
Complexity and mechanism baseline ratchets must see no new violations after value-preserving key re-spells for path migrations, with operator sanction recorded in commit messages
